Which one are you squaring first?

How much can Bear² pay?

NVDA, TSLA, PLTR: up to 4× (floor at −50%)
AAPL: up to 2.8× (floor at −40%)
SPY: up to 2× (floor at −30%)

The floor caps the gain. Know it before you buy.

What is carry?

A small daily cost that lowers the token's value the longer you hold.

Set from each stock's volatility: calm stocks cost less to hold than wild ones. Shown before you buy.

Market closed? You can still sell.

Prices use the latest oracle price with wider spreads. New buys pause if that price gets too old.

Your token stays in your wallet the whole time.

Explore stock moves.
Before you trade.

Pick a market, set the move, set the days held. See what $1,000 becomes in Bull² and Bear² after carry.

Is there always money to pay Bear² holders?

The Bear² vault is built to hold enough cash to pay every Bear² token at its max value, and it blocks new buys before that limit is reached.
